notes.title: The Future of Drug Lord Tycoon
notes.content:
[h3]🧪 The Future of Drug Lord Tycoon[/h3][p]Many of you have noticed that we have not released an update for Drug Lord Tycoon for a couple of months now. [b]Many of you have been worried that we have abandoned the game[/b], [i]which we have not![/i][/p][p][/p][p]Since the release of a popular game similar to ours we have been uncertain about the game's direction. We've had many ideas on how to change our game, and we want to deliver the best version of our game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We have some big changes coming[/b], but you will have to wait a little longer. We have read your feedback and here is how the future of Drug Lord Tycoon is going to look. [/p][p][/p][h3]🌿Drug system overhaul[/h3][p]The drugs have lacked depth, and therefore we are [b]overhauling the drugs completely[/b]. Every drug will now have [b]more depth.[/b] [/p][p]For example: you will be able to make custom strains of weed by crossbreeding strains and customizing traits. The same goes for all other drugs, where there will be similar depth to each, [b]allowing you to optimize and customize your drugs.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]📍 Progress and locations[/h3][p]Right now each location is very generic, and we want to change that as well. [b]Each location will be unique[/b] and designed to support one specific drug, with the layout and conditions optimized for that drug alone. [/p][p]This means that new drugs will be unlocked by purchasing new properties, making expansion more meaningful and strategic.[/p][p][/p][h3]💼 Management[/h3][p]A lot of your feedback has also involved the lack of money management, and so far the game hasn’t delivered much on the “tycoon” part of the name. [/p][p]We are currently working on adding [b]more financial depth[/b] to the game and [b]balancing current systems.[/b] [/p][p]
[/p][p]We are still shaping exactly what that looks like, and we would love to hear your ideas. What systems would you like to see? And what’s missing?[/p][p][/p][h3]❓Questions and more[/h3][p]If you have any questions about these changes, you can join our [url="https://discord.gg/8xNkh4jrvK" style="button"]Discord[/url] where we also post more announcements and showcase progress.[/p][p][/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: Passive Production
notes.content:
[h1]Passive Production[/h1]  
[b]Passive Production[/b] allows your properties to continue producing even when you're not present. This makes it possible to produce drugs over time without having to actually be at the warehouse where the drugs are being produced. Have one warehouse for weed and one for meth, and they'll both reward you with product at the same time!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195753/692c17a1690d2ea467c8b9bd7b6de924a868a29a.png[/img]

[h1]Bills[/h1]  
Until now, producing drugs has been a breeze—living without a worry in your warehouse. But now, a new tab has been added to the computer: [b]Bills[/b]. Here, you'll need to pay for utilities such as water and electricity.

Workers' salaries are now also paid through the Bills tab instead of automatically being deducted from your bank. This provides a better overview of all your expenses.

Just remember to [b]pay your bills on time[/b]—if you don't, the police will get suspicious and eventually raid your warehouse, taking everything from that location!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195753/369ecefdc2853de1450d6d32e50bbbdc4a622255.png[/img]

[h1]Quality of Life and other changes[/h1]  
Some much-needed [b]quality of life improvements[/b] have been made in this update. These include the ability to rename your properties and view a "live" preview image of the property when selecting it in the Real Estate tab.

We've also combined the Workers and Dealers tabs into a single [b]"Staff"[/b] tab. From here, you can select the type of worker you want to hire or manage. The process is the same as before, except Restockers now have their own page.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195753/43d14c7f1be55a32cae8b9acd2c45df4314dab7b.png[/img]

[h1]Full list of changes[/h1]  
+ Added Passive Production  
+ Added the ability to rename properties  
+ Added Bills  
Failure to pay your bills will result in a police raid of your property

* The preview image for owned properties now displays an interior view of the building  
* Changed the skill tree  
The meth skill tree is now an extension of the weed skill tree instead of being parallel  
* Combined “Dealers” and “Workers” tabs into a single “Staff” tab  
* Fixed an issue where pressing Play would crash the game if a save file was corrupted  
* Improved save game stability  
* Fixed weed workers ignoring newly placed drying racks  
* Fixed an issue where you wouldn't gain Rep for removing evidence after a dealer had been taken by a rival distributor  
* Slightly reduced the Rep required to level up

notes.title: Worker bugfix
notes.content:
We have reworked the entire worker code, fixing all major bugs surrounding workers

[b]Changes[/b]

- Reworked the entire worker code from scratch
- Weed workers now plant seed right after harvesting plants
- Workers no longer play an animation when harvesting dried weed, speeding up the process
- A notification now pops up telling you why a property is locked

[b]Fixes[/b]
* Workers no longer get stuck at tasks
* Restockers no longer complain about lack of shelf space when shelves aren’t full.

notes.title: Distributors Part 1
notes.content:
This is the first of two parts of the distributor update, we split this update into two parts since many players have felt that they have too much product to sell using just dealers. Making both parts of the distributor update would take longer, and we wanted to give you the opportunity to sell product in bulk as early as possible.

[h2]About the update[/h2]
Distributors now control the city, each one has a piece of it, their territory, where they operate. [b]Once you have 1000g of any product[/b], the distributor whose territory you’re in, will show up, and ask to make a deal, once he shows up you will be able to see distributors and their territories on the real estate map.

You can now choose to either accept or decline their deal. If you accept the deal, [b]a pallet will show up in front of your property[/b], this is where you will load the product, and where the distributor will show up to collect it. If you decline, the distributor will walk away, but he will come back one day later, with a new deal.

To package product for a distributor, all you have to do is go to your packaging table, and click on the “distributor” tab, from here you will be able to get an overview of the order, as well as [b]package the order in chunks of 1000g packages[/b].

Once it’s time for the distributor to pick up the product, he will send you a text message, and arrive to pick up the order shortly after. Here he will pay you and walk away with the product. Using a distributor also gives a [b]great amount of EXP.[/b]

But note: You can only fulfil a distributor's order while you are in his territory.

[h2]About part 2:[/h2]
As mentioned, this update is split in two. Here is what you can expect in part 2 of the distributor update.

Declining orders will not just make the distributor go away, but you might make yourself an enemy, if he thinks you’re overstepping in his territory. The distributors will falsely call the police to your place, meaning you will have to hide and pause production while the police check you out. The distributor will also try to catch and beat your dealers, meaning you will lose the product he was dealing, and potentially also the dealer himself.

But he won’t be able to make your life miserable forever, since you will also be able to defeat the distributor entirely and overtake his territory! Once defeated, you will be able to deal in his former territory with your product in bulk yourself, meaning a smaller cut will be taken from your product.
